layoutHelp: Arrange panels without discarding the manuscript or tool inputs. Saved per novel.
savePanelFirst: Save or cancel the reference panel edits before changing the layout.
layoutApplied: Workspace arranged. Manuscript content is unchanged.
layoutSaved: Personal layout saved for this novel.
mirrorNote: Read-only mirror of the current manuscript, updated as you type. There is only one editor that can save.
commandSideHelp: Right-click chapter, character or reference results to read beside the manuscript
batchSafety: Up to 100 at a time. Undo organization or restore recycled records. Chapter and Final Check status are separate.
trashEmpty: The recycle bin is empty. Recycled records can be restored here.
recordsEmpty: No matching records. Change the filters or capture an idea.
todoCreated: Chapter task created. Continue in Chapter tasks.
loreProposalNote: Proposed for lore organization. Create and review a candidate in World settings before formal adoption.
loreProposalNotice: Organization intent recorded. Formal lore has not been created or changed.
editSafety: Edits only this author record, retaining links, sources and revision history. External changes are never overwritten.
saveEditFirst: Unsaved edits remain. Save or discard them inside the dialog.
editSavingReceipt: Saving this submission. You can keep editing; wait for its receipt before closing.
editNewerRetained: The submission was saved. Edits made while waiting are retained and have not been saved yet.
editReceiptMissing: The save receipt does not contain this record. Your edits are retained; check the record before continuing.
